projects.title: Interactive Quiz & Custom Event Bus
projects.purpose: Master JavaScript closures, higher-order functions, custom EventEmitter, and object literals.

milestones.title: EventEmitter pattern from scratch
milestones.requirements: Implement an EventEmitter class with on(event, callback), off(event, callback), and emit(event, data).
acceptance_criteria: Multiple listeners can subscribe to the same event
emit triggers callbacks in registration order with arguments
off removes the specified callback accurately
milestones.hint: Store listeners as an object mapping event names to arrays of callbacks: this.events[name] = [].

milestones.title: Quiz state machine
milestones.requirements: Build a QuizEngine that holds question models, current question index, score, and emits question:change and quiz:end events.
acceptance_criteria: answer() method validates selected option and updates score
Advances to next question until all answered
Emits events to decouple state from UI display

milestones.title: CLI interaction loop
milestones.requirements: Wire readline interface or simulated console prompts to quiz events, showing timer and score summary.
acceptance_criteria: Handles invalid option selections gracefully
Displays formatted percentage and grade upon completion
Cleanly exits the Node.js event loop on finish
milestones.hint: Use readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout }).

extensions: Add countdown timer per question using setTimeout / clearTimeout
Load questions dynamically from JSON file

projects.title: Asynchronous Concurrent Data Pipeline
projects.purpose: Harness asynchronous JavaScript: Promises, async/await, Promise.allSettled, rate-limiting, and error fallback.

milestones.title: Async API fetch wrapper with retry
milestones.requirements: Write fetchWithRetry(url, maxRetries, delayMs) using Promise and exponential backoff.
acceptance_criteria: Retries failed requests up to maxRetries times
Doubles delay interval between attempts
Rejects with informative error when attempts exhausted
milestones.hint: Use async/await in a for loop and await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, delay)).

milestones.title: Concurrent multi-source aggregator
milestones.requirements: Fetch data from multiple simulated weather endpoints concurrently using Promise.allSettled.
acceptance_criteria: Does not fail entire batch if one endpoint returns error
Filters and extracts fulfilled values safely
Computes average temperature across successful responses
milestones.hint: Iterate through results filtering by r.status === "fulfilled".

milestones.title: Data transformation and caching layer
milestones.requirements: Implement an in-memory TTL Cache with get(key) and set(key, value, ttlSeconds) to avoid duplicate network calls.
acceptance_criteria: Subsequent calls within TTL serve from memory
Stale data expires and re-fetches cleanly
Logs cache HIT vs MISS metrics
milestones.hint: Store Map with object { value, expiry: Date.now() + ttl * 1000 }.

extensions: Implement concurrency throttler (limit to N parallel requests)
Write tests mocking fetch with Jest or Node test runner
Export aggregated weather report to markdown

projects.title: Reactive State Store & Virtual Pub/Sub
projects.purpose: Master advanced JS: Proxy-based reactivity, deep property observation, batch updating, and immutable history.

milestones.title: Deep reactive Proxy observer
milestones.requirements: Create createStore(initialState) that wraps objects in Proxy to intercept get and set traps recursively.
acceptance_criteria: Intercepts mutations at any depth level
Notifies subscribers with old and new values
Does not trigger notifications if value didn't change (Object.is check)
milestones.hint: In set trap, reflect update and call notifySubscribers(prop, val, oldVal).

milestones.title: Computed properties & dependency tracking
milestones.requirements: Implement computed(getter) that automatically tracks accessed store properties and caches computed values.
acceptance_criteria: Re-evaluates only when tracked dependencies change
Caches result for multiple reads without re-computing
Supports multiple independent computed derivations
milestones.hint: Set an activeEffect pointer during getter execution to register dependencies.

milestones.title: Time-travel state history
milestones.requirements: Implement undo() and redo() mechanics using immutable state snapshots or patch deltas.
acceptance_criteria: Every mutation pushes state snapshot to past stack
undo() restores previous state and notifies UI
redo() replays forward history cleanly
milestones.hint: Use structuredClone() to clone snapshots before applying mutations.

extensions: Implement action middleware pattern (logging, crash reporting)
Batch multiple synchronous mutations into a single microtask notify with queueMicrotask
Serialize and restore entire state store from localStorage
